name: diag_gpu_pack_payload_mode_restore_01
command:
"""Authorized one-off recovery of original payload permissions, never bytes."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
from src.tools.pbs_mixed_accounting import logged, reference, read_reference

root = Path.cwd().resolve()
assert os.environ.get('CVPR_RUN_NAME') == 'diag_gpu_pack_payload_mode_restore_01'
items = [
    ('709349.hopper-m-02', 'gpu_pack_training_single_01', 'gpu_pack_training_single_01-20261109T225356Z-d587de07'),
    ('709350.hopper-m-02', 'gpu_pack_training_single_02', 'gpu_pack_training_single_02-20261109T225606Z-ded8d8d9'),
]
verified = []
for job, name, receipt_dir in items:
    payload_path = root / 'logs/pbs' / receipt_dir / 'payload.json'
    payload_ref = reference(payload_path, root)
    payload, _ = read_reference(root, payload_ref)
    pack, _ = logged(root, reference(root / 'results' / (name + '.json'), root))
    parent_ref = pack['config']['parent_payload_reference']
    _, linked = read_reference(root, parent_ref, root / 'logs/pbs')
    assert linked == payload_path.resolve() and parent_ref['sha256'] == payload_ref['sha256']
    assert payload['name'] == name and payload['dry_run'] is False
    assert pack['config']['pbs_jobid'] == job
    assert pack['metrics']['all_owned_units_ended'] is True and pack['metrics']['cleanup_errors'] == []
    receipt_path = payload_path.with_name('submission.json')
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_bytes())
    assert receipt['returncode'] == 0 and receipt['stdout'].strip() == job
    original = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', '82031465:' + str(payload_path.relative_to(root))],
                              check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
    assert original == payload_path.read_bytes()
    assert stat.S_IMODE(payload_path.stat().st_mode) == 0o644
    claim_refs = []
    for entry in pack['metrics']['unit_claims']:
        claim, _ = read_reference(root, entry['claim_reference'], Path(pack['config']['queue_root']))
        assert claim['pbs_jobid'] == job and claim['unit_id'] == entry['unit_id']
        _, claim_payload = read_reference(root, claim['parent_payload_reference'], root / 'logs/pbs')
        assert claim_payload == payload_path.resolve()
        assert claim['parent_payload_reference']['sha256'] == payload_ref['sha256']
        claim_refs.append(entry['claim_reference'])
    assert claim_refs
    failed_name = name + '_mixed_accounting'
    meta_path = root / 'logs/runs' / (failed_name + '.meta.json')
    failed_meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_bytes())
    assert failed_meta['exit_code'] == 1 and failed_meta.get('end')
    assert failed_meta.get('results_missing') is True
    assert not (root / 'results' / (failed_name + '.json')).exists()
    log_path = root / 'logs/runs' / (failed_name + '.log')
    assert 'Mixed accounting requires an original immutable submitted payload' in log_path.read_text()
    artifacts = [log_path, meta_path]
    diff_path = root / 'logs/runs' / (failed_name + '.diff')
    if diff_path.exists(): artifacts.append(diff_path)
    if failed_meta.get('git_diff_path'):
        recorded_diff = (root / failed_meta['git_diff_path']).resolve()
        assert recorded_diff in [p.resolve() for p in artifacts]
    archive = root / 'results/_archive' / (failed_name + '.before_permission_restore_01')
    assert not archive.exists()
    verified.append(dict(job=job, name=name, path=payload_path, ref=payload_ref,
                         receipt=reference(receipt_path, root), claims=claim_refs,
                         artifacts=artifacts, archive=archive,
                         original_commit='82031465', original_git_sha256=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()))

# No mutation until both original payloads, claimed copies and ended failures agree.
records = []
for item in verified:
    archived = []
    item['archive'].mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    for source in item['artifacts']:
        before = reference(source, root)
        target = item['archive'] / source.name
        shutil.move(str(source), str(target))
        after = reference(target, root)
        assert before['sha256'] == after['sha256'] and before['bytes'] == after['bytes']
        archived.append({'original': before, 'archived': after})
    before_mode = stat.S_IMODE(item['path'].stat().st_mode)
    item['path'].chmod(0o444)
    after_ref = reference(item['path'], root)
    assert after_ref == item['ref']
    after_mode = stat.S_IMODE(item['path'].stat().st_mode)
    assert after_mode == 0o444
    records.append({'job': item['job'], 'pack_name': item['name'],
                    'payload_reference': after_ref, 'original_git_commit': item['original_commit'],
                    'original_git_sha256': item['original_git_sha256'],
                    'parent_and_claim_sha_verified': True, 'claim_references': item['claims'],
                    'submission_reference': item['receipt'], 'before_mode': oct(before_mode),
                    'after_mode': oct(after_mode), 'payload_bytes_unchanged': True,
                    'archived_failed_artifacts': archived,
                    'original_failed_result_absent': True})
print('PAYLOAD_PERMISSION_RECOVERY_JSON: ' + json.dumps(records, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False), flush=True)
